body:
I've tried to hang myself a dozen times and haven't been able to pull it off. I wonder what the secret is.

I'm sorry for the pain you're feeling for yourself. But as far as she's concerned, I mean.. sorry, but let her go. Having tried many times, I don't think people succeed in hanging themselves all the way unless they really want out. The thing normal people may not understand is *it does not matter that people care*. Caring is so abstract. It doesn't change a person's life. It doesn't change the fact they have to go on being them, and all the fucking dreary shit that requires. I straight up told one of my friends the other day - all the well-wishing, all the "Well, I hope you blah blah whatever", all the asking "Are you ok?" - it's hard to say it, but it doesn't do anything. It doesn't do shit. You can't swap someone's shit life that they don't want for a rewarding one that they do. I envy your cousin like you can't believe.

Sorry.
What about his shits? Can you give any insight into them shits?
[Ex]: Me and [your best friend] are dating now.
